headline: Artemis Medicare Services reports Q2 FY27 financial results
hook: Revenue growth outpaces profit growth at Artemis
summary: Artemis Medicare Services posted a 13.2% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue from operations for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Adjusted EBITDA grew 22.7% compared to the same period last year, while reported EBITDA rose 7.9%. Net profit for the quarter increased by 3.7% year-on-year. Retail investors in the healthcare sector can track these operating margins and earnings growth figures.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings shape sentiment for hospital stocks
winners_losers: Artemis holders gain / no clear losers
